construction.implementation_origin: Authored from scratch in isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Object with schema_version, synthetic=true, processing_residency EU/US and accounts, tickets, usage_records, billing_adjustments, documents, requirements arrays. All array records require unique safe id and matching residency.
shared_schema.entities: Subscriber accounts declare GDPR/CCPA, protection, purpose, lawful basis and fixed fictitious phone/dummy IMEI. Tickets and usage reference accounts. Adjustments require finite amount and nonblank reason.
shared_schema.documents: Support chat text or CDR CSV, plus explicit entity_ids. CDR header: id,account_id,residency,call_seconds,data_mb. Every CSV row must agree with the linked usage record.
shared_schema.requirements: entity_type account/ticket/usage, entity_id, document_ids and nonempty required_terms
shared_schema.output: schema_version, synthetic, status, processing_residency, review_state, summary, findings and notice. Findings carry requirement/entity IDs, residency, supporting/inspected document IDs and a gap reason; no raw personal data or transcripts.
shared_schema.errors: One JSON object with schema_version, status=error and sanitized message; CLI exit 2

cross_stage_handoffs: Single review stage: shared validation -> deterministic evidence matching -> content-free traceable findings
behavior: All required case-insensitive literal substrings must occur within one explicitly linked document; no semantic truth inference.
Missing evidence is a review gap, not a validation error; an empty requirement list is not_assessed.
Declared residency must match processing region on every structured record and CSV row.
Demonstrative GDPR/CCPA declarations and output minimization; no certification or actual data-residency enforcement.
Example fixture is explicitly synthetic, uses invented tickets and fictitious phone/dummy IMEI; usage is seeded pseudo-random.
No LLM step or provider needed. Deterministic and nonmutating.
